BC_description: The .parse and .unparse methods have been removed in version 3.0.0 as part of a scoping decision to focus the library solely on UUID generation. These methods, which enabled conversion between UUID strings and binary buffers, are no longer available. Code that relies on uuid.parse(string) to convert a UUID string into a buffer or uuid.unparse(buffer) to convert a buffer into a UUID string will break.
Reference: Issue: Parse/unparse methods removed in v3??
Adaptation_method: Replace usage of .parse() and .unparse() with external libraries such as 'uuid-parse' (https://github.com/zefferus/uuid-parse) for converting between UUID strings and buffers. For example: import { parse, unparse } from 'uuid-parse'; const buffer = parse('02a2ce90-1432-11e1-8558-0b488e4fc115'); const str = unparse(buffer);
